svg.aria-label: An isometric bench that shows how Cruise works. Messages ride a conveyor under a small judge. The judge moves a three-notch effort fader up or down from the app's own setting, never past a top stop. A ten-cell context gauge fills up and, at 60% and 80%, lights its warning lamps and raises a /handoff tag. A progress strip tracks the request.

text.tspan: 2 · A tiny judge reads only that
3 · It sets the effort the job needs:
lower for a quick fix, higher for a hard one
